title: Clear Window
status: Published; native, public-window and downloaded-backup software gates complete; physical Quest retest remains open
physicalFeedback: The owner found 0.14.0 AR diorama unplayable: a translucent head-correlated sheet obscured the game and combined movement, aim, fire and reload were unclear or unusable. Earlier synthetic passes do not override that negative physical playtest.
changes: Window modes retain a thin frame but render no filled shell membranes and hide only explicitly marked decorative camera-facing cloud backdrops.
Gameplay status has a transparent background; explicit pause menus remain room-anchored. Custom materials refresh per-eye uniforms on each draw.

Window combat uses independent left-stick movement, both right-stick aim axes and avatar-origin shots. Tracked pointing no longer overwrites aim or gates firing into empty space; misleading tracked gun/laser proxies are hidden during window play.
First-person AR now selects a player-eye camera inside the fixed diorama aperture instead of room-filling life-size AR. Head viewing remains independent of avatar movement and aim.

touchWindowControls.B: Reload directly without opening a menu
touchWindowControls.hands: Spatial menus only; not hand-only combat or locomotion

preserved.siblingWork: Scoped comparisons through master 852696ecb693e01ab6e977c485863567e287367a contain no intervening Aether or root chooser changes. Closeout changes only this receipt and the Aether shared-library summary.

native.scope: Actual HTTP WebGL application using ordinary UI and synthetic Gamepad/Touch/hand inputs. GPU fixtures are separate rendering cases. No actor, health, inventory, mission or saved-state assignment is used for gameplay acceptance. Duplicate independent regressions are not added to the main count.

publication.scope: The deployed descendant includes the exact Aether source above and concurrent sibling changes. Public file hashes, not commit-name similarity, establish equivalence.

publicWindowGameplay.scope: Separate actual public HTTPS application, full pixel density at 960x640 in the supported low graphics profile. Tests combine movement, both aim axes, fine aim and firing, reload while moving, head roll/lean, safe pause and hand-operated Exit across third-person AR, first-person AR window and third-person VR. Synthetic devices and software rendering are not physical Quest approval.
